text:
aj: kicking off a small rollout for the quant kernel patch (quant-kernel v2.2.0). matmul microcode + kv-cache layout change. plan is prebake -> 5% slice -> 1h smoke -> step to 25/50 if stable. requesting quick signoff and any last-minute compatibility concerns.

maya: quick checklist: have prebake artifacts in `gcr/redwood/quant:v2.2.0`? smoke scripts updated to hit long-context paths? do we have a preserved baseline for model-level bit-exact checks?

li: prebake done, image is published. smoke harness updated to include heavy prompt and cached-prefix path. baseline eval set uploaded to s3://redwood-smoke/quant/v2.1.4-baseline.jsonl.

samir: perf metrics to watch: p50/p95 token latency, matmul GFLOP/s, kv cache hit ratio, and error rates (400/500). add `exact-match-eval` to watch for regressions.

aj: deploy command we'll use (preflight run by myself):
```
/deploy canary --image=gcr/redwood/quant:v2.2.0 --slice=5% --regions=eu-west-1,us-west-2 --preflight=smoke --rollout-window=02:00-05:00UTC
```
please ack if you are on-call for the window.

ops-oncall: I'm on for the window. will escalate to platform-sre if we see 2x error spike or >10% latency regression.

deploy-bot: build 9876 prebake complete. canary job created id=canary-199874. Targets: eu-west-1 (3 pods), us-west-2 (2 pods). slice=5%.

perf-bot: preflight smoke started. running evals: `long-context`, `kv-cache-regen`, `exact-match-eval`. ETA ~8m.

perf-bot: smoke results: long-context p50:+1ms, p95:+12ms, kv-cache hit stable. exact-match-eval: 99.2% -> 98.5% (delta -0.7%). attaching small diff sample: top 10 mismatches.

maya: noting the exact-match delta. it's small but visible on the eval set for a frequently used prompt family (reasoning-chains). can we reproduce locally on a pinned prod model?

li: repro attempt on single-node with quant:v2.2.0 + same weights: reproduces ~same deltas on the eval set. logs show a subtle fp-rounding change in matmul kernel at long sequences.

aj: proposed course: pause progression beyond 5% until we confirm root cause. Options: 1) rollback canary to v2.1.4, 2) pin the new kernel at 5% and mark as holdback, 3) patch microcode and re-prebake. I prefer option 2 for customer-facing reliability while we triage. any objections?

samir: agree with 2. keep canary running for telemetry collection, but do not advance. create an incident ticket and tag model/owners. if exact-match drops >1% on aggregate or error/latency crosses thresholds, auto-rollback.

ops-oncall: setting temporary traffic policy: block promotions from canary -> steady for this release. I'll update routing rules and monitor.

deploy-bot: update: progression paused per request. canary id=canary-199874 remains at 5%. promotion blocked by policy `holdback/quant-v2.2.0`.

aj: created ticket INF-4823 with reproductions and attached diff and repro script. assigning to li + perf. Also adding release-note entry draft: "quant-kernel v2.2.0: matmul microcode + kv-cache layout — held at 5% due to small exact-match regressions on reasoning prompts; patch expected."

li: working on narrowing kernel paths that cause rounding difference. will attempt a micro-patch and prebake a `v2.2.1-cand` today.

maya: ops: can we add a temporary traffic label so that downstream billing/observability marks these requests? want to be sure experiments don't pollute cost dashboards.

ops-oncall: done — canary traffic labeled `quant-experiment:v2.2.0-hold`. metrics and billing segmented.

perf-bot: baseline vs canary continuous snapshot configured. streaming diffs to #eng-runtime-telemetry.

aj: thanks all. next update in 30m or earlier if anything spikes. please react with :thumbsup: when you see this.

li: :thumbsup: starting debug now.

(30m later)

perf-bot: anomaly alert: small increase in short-circuit 500s from eu-west-1 (5->12 over 10m). investigating logs for stack traces.

ops-oncall: looking — 500s appear tied to a rare kernel codepath with oversized sequences hitting an unhandled path in the new kv-cache layout. will throttle canary read timeouts to reduce error surface.

aj: decision tree: if 500-rate > 10/min or p95 latency > 2x baseline -> rollback to v2.1.4. current numbers: 500-rate trending ~1/min (below threshold), p95 within 1.15x. we hold.

samir: creating a quick hotfix checklist in the ticket: reproduce -> isolate matmul kernel line -> try guard condition -> micro-bump quant kernel -> prebake -> smoke. target turnaround 4h.

li: quick note — I can produce a candidate `v2.2.1-cand` with a guarded matmul path in ~2.5h. I'll request a new prebake and short canary (5% -> smoke).

aj: good. ops, keep promotions blocked and keep the canary labeled. I'll update release notes to reflect holdback and ongoing investigation.

deploy-bot: note: promotion block will prevent any automated staged rollouts. manual override requires `release-lead` + `platform-sre` approval.

maya: thanks. adding a short blurb to the weekly release notes: "quant-kernel v2.2.0 deployed to 5% for telemetry; progression paused due to small exact-match regressions and rare 500s on specific long-sequence flows. Investigation ongoing; expected micro-patch."

li: will post candidate and prereqs in this thread when prebake completes.

aj: closing loop for now — we have a clear rollback threshold, traffic pinned, and tasks assigned. reopen thread with any urgent changes.

samir: :eyes:

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: all set.

deploy-bot: canary-199874 status=paused slice=5% label=quant-experiment:v2.2.0-hold
